description: Multi-provider discovery (live REAL merchants by default). Returns a ranked page (default limit=30, max 100) with total/has_more/next_offset. Follow next.args (search_id+offset+limit) to page without re-fanout. Optional fetch_limit (max 300) deepens the upstream pull on new searches. Pass include_sandbox=true only to append DEMO/SANDBOX test merchants at the bottom (test_offer=true). Always pass agent_id for mandate-aware badges. Carry search_id through supply_details / order_execute / order_feedback. Offer descriptions are clean text cut to 350 chars; supply_details returns the full text.

agent_id.description: Agent id for mandate-aware badges (always pass when available)

anyOf.description: Legacy: max total budget in USD
Max total budget in the given currency (indicative FX for other currencies)

currency.description: ISO currency for budget, e.g. USD

budget.description: Max total budget — number means USD; or { amount, currency }

country.description: ISO country for ships-to, e.g. US

fetch_limit.description: Optional override for per-merchant upstream pull (default max(20, limit*2), max 300). Ignored when paging via search_id+offset

include_sandbox.description: Include DEMO/SANDBOX merchants (listed last, test_offer=true). Default false — live REAL merchants only. Use only when testing Conduit checkout flows.

limit.description: Page size of ranked offers to return (default 30, max 100)

offset.description: 0-based offset into the ranked set for this search_id (default 0). For page 2+, pass search_id from the prior response and follow next.args

payable_with.description: Filter to rails the agent can pay with, e.g. ["x402"]

query.description: Product search query, e.g. USB-C charger 65W. Required for a new search; omit when paging with search_id + offset

search_id.description: Resume paging into a prior ranked set (with offset>0, or offset 0 without query). New searches with query mint a fresh search_id

session_token.description: Session token from agent_authenticate — required whenever agent_id is passed
